author: .just_kk
content:
Lets ship it one way or another. I don't want to wait for I* to enable fast payload propagation.

My preferred way is still as it is described in the 8142 [PR](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12072/). (note changes since my presentation on ACDC: no more unified subnets with data columns and payload propagation uses merkle commitment instead of KZG). 

The minimal change that would require an EIP/Fork is a new execution bid field with payload commitment (I think we have a consensus that merkle root for chunks tree should work).  

(Honestly, if we can introduce that new field already in G* then we can ship chunked broadcast without waiting for H* or I*)

Assuming this commitment is in the bid we can add payload chunks topic (or PeerDAS style subnets, or waggle style streams, whatever). This could be optional and co-exist with execution_payload topic for some time. Then this new payload broadcast scheme becomes mandatory at some fork and execution_payload topic is deprecated.

I am proposing bid update and introducing chunks subnets in 8142 [PR](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12072/)) which is PFIed for Hegota . Happy to replace payload column subnets with other alternatives as long as they do not introduce too much implementation complexity (such as introducing a new transport) and provide a clear path to eventually upgrading to mandatory proofs vision when peers will require to custody pieces of execution payload without downloading it in full
